body.purpose: Default prose and UI text, including headings.

label.purpose: Status strip, column headers, breadcrumb — uppercase micro-labels.

readout.purpose: Large tabular-numeral display on the halted-clock pages.

motion.name: ease-out-quint
motion.purpose: Filter-list transitions; replaced an overshoot/bounce easing that read as playful rather than mechanical.

components.name: Severity Meter
components.description: 5-cell discrete horizontal bar indicating topic severity 1-5, driven by a --n custom property.
components.css: .ds-sev { display: block; position: relative; height: 8px; width: 100%; } .ds-sev::before, .ds-sev::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; height: 100%; width: 100%; background-size: 20% 100%; background-image: linear-gradient(to right, currentColor 0 calc(100% - 3px), transparent calc(100% - 3px) 100%); } .ds-sev::before { color: #46403a; } .ds-sev::after { color: #ff4d2e; clip-path: inset(0 calc((5 - var(--n)) * 20%) 0 0); }

components.name: Status Cell
components.description: One key/value pair in the header status strip.
components.css: .ds-status-cell { padding: 0 0.75rem; border-left: 1px solid #2e2a24; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-status-key { color: #b0a696; margin-right: 0.4em; } .ds-status-val { color: #e4ded4; } .ds-status-val.is-hot { color: #ff7a5c; } .ds-status-val.is-ok { color: #3fe06b; }

components.name: Topic Row
components.description: One row of the topic index: row index, name, severity meter, description in a shared 4-column grid.
components.html: 07active directoryNetBIOS: 15 characters of permanent regret
components.css: .ds-topic-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 3.5ch 20ch 6rem 1fr; gap: 1.25rem; align-items: center; padding: 0.6rem; color: #e4ded4; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid #2e2a24; } .ds-topic-row:hover, .ds-topic-row:focus-visible { background: #211e19; } .ds-idx { color: #b0a696; } .ds-item-name { color: #f5f1ea; } .ds-item-desc { color: #b0a696; }

components.name: Readout
components.description: Large centered tabular-numeral display used on halted-clock pages.
components.css: .ds-readout { background: #191713; padding: 1.25rem 1.35rem; text-align: center; } .ds-readout-value { font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 12vw, 4.5rem); line-height: 1; font-weight: 700; color: #ff7a5c; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-readout-unit { font-size: 0.85rem; color: #b0a696; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Bordered content card used in the in-memoriam grid and similar listing pages.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #191713; border: 1px solid #2e2a24; padding: 1rem 1.15rem; transition: background 0.1s; } .ds-card:hover { background: #211e19; } .ds-card h3 { color: #f5f1ea; font-size: 0.95rem; }

narrative.overview: A dead-serious operations dashboard rendering the trivial and the absurd as if it were a live production outage. Every recurring tech annoyance in the catalogue gets treated with the visual gravity of a real severity-tracked incident: status strips, severity meters, tabular readouts, monospace throughout. The joke is entirely in the gap between the instrumentation and the subject matter — the system itself must never wink at the reader.
keyCharacteristics: Amber-on-charcoal, zero rounded corners, zero drop shadows
Tabular numerals and monospace everywhere, including prose
Column-grid tables with row indices and inline severity meters
Status strip / breadcrumb chrome that classic mode strips out entirely

rules.name: The 7:1 Rule
rules.body: Every color used for text meets WCAG AAA (7:1 body / 4.5:1 large). --hot-deep (5.68:1) is reserved for bars and rules and must never carry text.

rules.name: The 12px Floor Rule
rules.body: No text renders below a 12px (0.75rem) equivalent, even for instrument-panel micro-labels.

rules.name: The Margin Fire Rule
rules.body: The animated fire background must stay in page margins (or become a contained masthead band on mobile) and never sit directly behind body text without a scrim.

rules.name: The Flat Console Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow or blur-based glow. Hierarchy is tonal-step + border only.

dos: Do keep every text color at or above 7:1 (4.5:1 for large text) against its background.
Do drive severity, count, and status displays from real data (_data/topics.yml), never hand-authored duplicates.
Do keep corners square and surfaces flat.
Do use --hot-deep only for bars/rules, never for text.
donts: Don't touch classic/**, the classic layouts, or classic CSS. Any new WIP chrome needs a matching html.classic-mode override.
Don't add box-shadow, drop-shadow glow, or bounce/overshoot easing.
Don't let the fire background sit directly behind readable text without a scrim/panel.
Don't add third-party embeds that render a visible broken/empty state when the network call fails.
